item.title: Leitrim councillors say Government must take action on forestry corridors
item.description: Councillors in Leitrim are hopeful that a meeting with ESB representatives will bear fruit. The county was bore the brunt of Storm Éowyn last January. Thousands of homes, farms and businesses were left without power for over three weeks. Among the issues in the county includes forestry corridors, with calls within Leitrim for them to be increased. Cllr Brendan Barry attended the meeting. He says the ball is in the government's court: Advertisement

item.title: Vigilance is key following Bluetongue outbreak, says IFA Chair
item.description: A meeting to discuss ways to prevent the spread of bluetongue among cows took place at the Department of Agriculture today. A case was confirmed in a cattle herd in County Wexford at the weekend. While the virus doesn't pose any threat to human health or food safety, it is spread among cattle and sheep by midges, Connacht IFA Chairperson Brendan Golden says while this case in unsurprising, it is important to remain vigilant: Advertisement

item.title: Ballinamore councillor welcomes update on bus shelters
item.description: A Leitrim councillor has welcomed progress on two new bus shelters for Ballinamore. Cllr Gary Prior had raised the issue at today's Municipal District meeting. He called on the local authority to provide a timeline for the delivery of bus stop facilities. Leitrim County Council said plans for the development would go on display this Wednesday. Cllr Prior says he hopes to see the shelters erected as quickly as possible: Advertisement

item.title: Longford man who raped elderly, vulnerable neighbour jailed for 13 years
item.description: By Isabel Hayes A man who attacked and raped his elderly, vulnerable neighbour during a violent home invasion, causing her “life-altering” harm, has been jailed for 13 years. Shane Kelly (36) forced his way into the 70-year-old woman's home late at night and subjected her to an ordeal in which he forced himself on her sexually, choked her and robbed her of petty cash, the Central Criminal Court heard.
